units.summary: Returns the IP address itself for IPv4, or a CIDR-notation subnet for IPv6. If you write a custom keyGenerator that allows a fallback to IP address for unauthenticated users, return ipKeyGenerator(req.ip) rather than just req.ip. For more information, {@see Options.ipv6Subnet}.

params.name: ip
params.doc: The IP address to process, usually request.ip.

params.name: ipv6Subnet
params.doc: The subnet mask for IPv6 addresses.

guarantees.text: An IPv4 address is returned unchanged.
When `ipv6Subnet` is not given it defaults to 56, so an IPv6 address is returned as the network address of its /56 subnet in CIDR notation.
With `ipv6Subnet` set to `false`, an IPv6 address is also returned unchanged.
An IPv4-mapped IPv6 address (the "::ffff:0:0/96" range) is returned as the IPv4 address it contains, whichever notation it arrives in.

units.summary: Create an instance of IP rate-limiting middleware for Express.

params.name: passedOptions
params.doc: Options to configure the rate limiter.

values: express-rate-limit: async error during store initialization.

guarantees.text: Setting `limit` to 0 blocks all requests instead of disabling the rate limiter.
`message` defaults to "Too many requests, please try again later.".
`legacyHeaders` defaults to true, which sends the "X-RateLimit-Limit", "X-RateLimit-Remaining" and (if the store provides it) "X-RateLimit-Reset" headers on all responses.
`requestPropertyName` defaults to "rateLimit", the name of the property on the request that holds the rate limit info.
